name: night-density-and-recovery-baseline-2026-05-17
description: Deterministic solver quality gates for unattended production operation. These gates are based on generated month, staffing, leave-cluster, and recovery scenarios after night-density and four-workday tuning.

interpretation.infeasible: Allowed only for intentionally over-constrained stress cases; production input should be stopped by feasibility diagnostics before calling this acceptable.
interpretation.tightNightBlock: Permitted as a monitored naturalness residual when night density, leave clusters, or recovery constraints force it.
interpretation.fourConsecutiveWork: Permitted only as a residual after the preferred max-three-consecutive objective.
interpretation.absenceCandidate: Allowed in recovery stress cases when public-holiday movement cannot absorb urgent leave.
